notes: Origin: Aristotle described a first principle as the first basis from which a thing is known. Modern popular example, widely reported: in a 2012 interview Elon Musk described battery packs costing around 600 dollars per kilowatt hour, then asked what the raw materials (cobalt, nickel, aluminium, carbon, polymers, a steel can) would cost on the metals market, and found it was around 80 dollars per kilowatt hour; the gap was in how packs were made. Contrast with reasoning by analogy: doing things because that is how they have always been done or how others do them. Method: 1) state the problem and the current assumptions, 2) break it down to what you know is definitely true, 3) rebuild a solution from those facts. Close with a question the listener can apply to a problem of their own this week.
